description:
We're building safety-enhancing technology for aviation that will save lives. Automated aviation systems will enable a future where air transportation is safer, more convenient and fundamentally transformative to the way goods — and eventually people — move around the planet. We are a team of mission-driven engineers with experience across aerospace, robotics and self-driving cars working to make this future a reality.



Flight Software links together the mechanical, avionics, algorithmic, and embedded worlds to actually make the airplane fly. As a Build Software Engineer on the Platform Engineering team, you are a software engineer who is passionate about build systems and making the developer experience meaningfully better. You will design and maintain the systems that build, test and deploy the entire flight software suite—this includes developing custom Rust command line tools.



As a Build Software Engineer, you will be part of the Platform Engineering team. The Platform Engineering team drives the productivity of Reliable’s flight software developers by providing the build infrastructure, developer tooling, continuous integration pipelines, hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) testbed integration, and cloud-based simulation deployments necessary to develop, test, and certify our autonomous aircraft software. You will help develop and maintain essential tools that enable developers at Reliable Robotics to deliver software products that are safe, successful, and meet certification requirements.



Responsibilities

 - Maintain and evolve our CMake-based build system to ensure all software builds supporting flight are fast, reliable, and repeatable across on-premise and cloud environments.

 - Scale the build system across a poly-repo environment, managing cross-repository dependencies, versioning, caching, and orchestration for C++, Rust, python and javascript codebases.

 - Refactor C++ code to be build-system-ready, untangling dependencies, modularizing targets, and improving compile and link times.

 - Develop internal CLI tools and build orchestration tooling using Rust to streamline developer workflows.

 - Partner across Flight Software, Embedded, Simulation, and IT/DevOps teams to ensure our build and CI pipelines support hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) testbeds, cloud simulations, and certification requirements.

Basic Success Criteria

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience

 - 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working with C++, with the ability to refactor C++ codebases to be build-system-ready

 - 2+ years of professional experience refactoring and maintaining a modern C++ build system (CMake and similar systems such as Ninja or Bazel)

 - Some experience with Rust (or strong interest in writing internal CLI and build tooling in Rust)

Preferred Success Criteria

 - Hands-on experience developing CLI tooling and developer automation in Rust - Experience with Starlark (Bazel / Buck2)

 - Experience scaling build and CI/CD systems across a multi-repo environment - Experience building tools to optimize Developer Experience (DevX), including clangd and IDE/language-server integration across multi-repo C++ codebases

 - Passionate about build systems, developer productivity, and eliminating workflow bottlenecks



This position requires access to information that is subject to U.S. export controls. An offer of employment will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to perform in compliance with U.S. export control laws.

All applicants are asked to provide documentation that legally establishes status as a U.S. person or non-U.S. person (and nationalities in the case of a non-U.S. person). At Reliable Robotics, our goal is to be a diverse and inclusive workforce. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, creed, ancestry, sex, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability or medical conditions, national origin, military or veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other basis covered by applicable law. All employment and promotion is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to work@reliable.co
